description: This file defines the ListViewSession class, which manages session-based state and navigation for list views in the vtiger CRM system. It includes methods for handling pagination, view navigation, session queries, and view change detection.

classes.name: ListViewSession
classes.description: Class responsible for managing list view session data, including current page, navigation, and query states in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: ListViewSession
methods.description: Constructor initializes default values for the list view session, setting the current module, default sort order, and start page.

methods.name: getCurrentPage
methods.description: Retrieves the current page start value from session data for a given module and view ID.

methods.name: getRequestStartPage
methods.description: Calculates and returns the start page from the request parameters, ensuring it is numeric and at least 1.

methods.name: getListViewNavigation
methods.description: Manages and retrieves the record navigation information for a list view, including page mapping and caching.

methods.name: getRequestCurrentPage
methods.description: Determines the current page for list view based on request parameters or session data, considering query mode and total record count.

methods.name: setSessionQuery
methods.description: Stores the current list query in session storage, clearing navigation cache if the query has changed.

methods.name: hasViewChanged
methods.description: Checks whether the current list view has changed based on the session and request parameters.
